headline: SKYWARD THUNDERPASS — a storm you fly through
lede: Gullwing Isle's fourth exam drives five gates straight through the thunderstorm: in at the rising west edge, down through a core that pulls two metres a second, out the east exit. Clear all five and the licence card sports STORM WINGS. The plane now feels weather too — gusts, downdraft, buffet and fog that closes to gate distance — and the thermals finally drift, cloud and lift moving as one field.
